name: Formulas and definitions
description: Search every formula and definition you wrote in your notes' front-matter (formula: and define: lists, written as "Label: content"), see the math rendered, copy it, or jump to the note.

settings.name: Front-matter keys to search
settings.desc: Comma-separated key=Label pairs, for example formula=Formula, define=Definition. Each key must be listed in indexedProperties in notes.config.json (formula, define and youtube are by default). The first letter of a key, its full name or its label works as a filter in the search box, e.g. f: or d:.

settings.name: Search button in the top bar
settings.desc: The command stays available when this is off.

settings.name: Search hotkey
settings.desc: Written like Mod+Alt+K (Mod is Ctrl on Windows/Linux and Cmd on Mac). Empty by default so it cannot clash with your browser.
